Dia 1.49.0 — "Your tool kit, in Dia" — 2026-09-17 (Issue No. 042)

MICROSOFT TOOL SUITE (the headline of this release)
  Outlook      email and calendar
  Teams        channel messages, thread analysis, meeting chat
  SharePoint   document changes and content
  Surfaced through a "Morning Brief" aggregation view
  (e.g. "a heads-up in your morning brief when a doc updates in SharePoint")

EXISTING, EXTENDED THIS RELEASE
  Slack        + voice note transcripts, + reading images/screenshots attached to messages

BETA TOOLS (4 new)
  Zoom         meetings, recordings, summaries, transcripts, notes, action items
  Salesforce   accounts, contacts, leads, cases, pipeline opportunities
  Figma        file search, comments, text/layer extraction from designs and FigJams
  Canva        design search, folder browsing, text and visual content

CATALOG IS OPEN-ENDED: users request further tools via Settings or
tool-requests@diabrowser.com.

*** NOT DOCUMENTED ANYWHERE ON THE PAGE: authorization/OAuth model, admin controls,
    tenant-side consent, audit surface, data retention. ***

ADJACENT: 2026-09-24 release note (body recovered same day) adds a Figma tool,
AI-response pause/resume, search over previous chats, collapsible PR stacks in
GitHub Live Folders, and a brand refresh.
